name: Chinese Zodiac
overview: Scripture reveals that the heavens, including the sun, moon, and stars, were created by God to serve as signs and to mark seasons and time (Genesis 1:14; Psalms 8:3; Psalms 19:1). However, the Bible warns against lifting our eyes to the celestial bodies with the intent to worship or serve them, as this leads away from the true worship of God (Deuteronomy 4:19; Deuteronomy 18:9). Practices such as astrology or consulting familiar spirits, which the Chinese Zodiac is associated with, are condemned as abominations and are not to be learned or followed by God's people (Leviticus 20:27; Deuteronomy 18:9).
